lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 high-contrast white vertical lines are visible. Spacing is significantly wider on the mid-torso (approx. 40-50 pixels) and narrows considerably as lines approach the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the 4th vertical line from the anterior. A second merging/splitting event is observed at the dorsal origin of the 9th line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 (anterior) and lines 11-12 (posterior) are highly abbreviated, terminating well before the ventral line. Lines 3, 5, and 7 show mid-torso termination points.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 distinct white circular spots is located on the posterior-lateral haunch, situated between the vertical line segments and the tail base.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-thigh align horizontally to create a brief linear geometric pattern parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white transverse band is visible across the lower throat. Distinct white facial markings are present, including two sub-orbital spots and a white patch on the bridge of the nose.
